note: Manistee NF campground on 33-acre Benton Lake, entirely surrounded by National Forest land, in Newaygo County; boat launch (no-wake/electric-motor lake). Usually quiet, but very popular in hunting season. The North Country Trail crosses Pierce Drive about 2 miles east of the entrance road. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated 2026-10-07): $30/night + $10 extra vehicle, senior/access 50% off, vault toilets and potable water (added), first-come only (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing exists), season Early May - Early September (added). Page shows 'Site Closed' now, i.e. past its season. Cleared sites.count 25 (unsourced; the page gives only a 31-vehicle parking capacity). No concessionaire named; managed by the Baldwin/White Cloud RD, phone (231) 745-4631 matches. No forest alert or order for the campground or its road. Hookups left (page silent).
